title: A moment bound for the standard Gaussian
statement: For the standard Gaussian measure $\gamma$ on $\mathbb R$, its fourth moment is at most three times the square of its second moment: $\int x^4\,d\gamma(x)\le 3\left(\int x^2\,d\gamma(x)\right)^2$.
